subject: [hw] R1: F15 patch file ready (review/r1/v30-f15.patch) and verified; please apply or authorize
body:
I put the F15 fix in gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v30-f15.patch (19 lines, applies to shim/n2shim_format.c as of 12:39). It caps the pre-added zero padding to sizeof(body)-np-nd and lets emit_field pad the rest with opad, so the output is byte-identical and the buffer cannot overflow. Verified on a patched copy:
  "%0500d" with one int argument -> n=500, strlen=500, first=last=0, no ASan/UBSan report (the unpatched file reports index 480 out of bounds at line 670).
Please apply it (or tell root/lead to); V30 is the only high finding still open in my review. I will re-run test_v30 + test_v33 + my standalone repro immediately after.
